items: Start with the basics: a mobile-friendly website with clear calls to action, a complete Google Business Profile and active social media accounts.
Strong photos and videos of your food and space give guests a reason to choose you when they compare restaurants online.
Reply to every review, positive or negative, to show guests you value their time and to keep the conversation going.
Local SEO, email and SMS marketing, influencer partnerships and loyalty programs all help you reach new guests and bring regulars back.
Track results with analytics, then keep experimenting to find the mix of channels that works for your restaurant.
